command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

samtools sort -@ 2 -o HG00096.chr20.bam aln.sam
samtools index HG00096.chr20.bam
samtools quickcheck -v HG00096.chr20.bam
samtools flagstat HG00096.chr20.bam > flagstat.txt
samtools idxstats HG00096.chr20.bam > idxstats.txt

# ---- smoke check: is this BAM real, and the right shape? ----
# Bands are set around values measured on this exact pinned input (see README);
# they are wide enough to survive aligner nondeterminism and tight enough that an
# empty, unmapped, truncated or wrong-reference BAM fails.
SQ=$(samtools view -H HG00096.chr20.bam | grep -c "^@SQ" || true)
REF=$(samtools view -H HG00096.chr20.bam | grep -c "SN:chr20.LN:64444167" || true)
PRIMARY=$(samtools view -c -F 0x900 HG00096.chr20.bam)
MAPPED=$(samtools view -c -F 0x904 HG00096.chr20.bam)
CONFIDENT=$(samtools view -c -q 30 -F 0x904 HG00096.chr20.bam)
PROPER=$(samtools view -c -f 0x2 -F 0x900 HG00096.chr20.bam)

{
  echo "sequences_in_header    $SQ            want 1"
  echo "chr20_len_matches_fai  $REF            want 1"
  echo "primary_records        $PRIMARY        want exactly 800000"
  echo "mapped_primary         $MAPPED         want 150000..350000  (observed 233036)"
  echo "mapq30_primary         $CONFIDENT      want  20000..150000  (observed  61160)"
  echo "properly_paired        $PROPER         want > 50000         (observed 132080)"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt
cat flagstat.txt

test "$SQ"        -eq 1
test "$REF"       -eq 1
test "$PRIMARY"   -eq 800000
test "$MAPPED"    -ge 150000
test "$MAPPED"    -le 350000
test "$CONFIDENT" -ge 20000
test "$CONFIDENT" -le 150000
test "$PROPER"    -gt 50000
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
